_doc: Canonical gem5 timing knobs (the 'timing config' a run uses). Each entry: the run_config key, the SIMSPECT_* env var it maps to (via pipeline._build_gem5_env), and what it does to the speculative window / branch resolution. SCAFFOLD — confirm values/semantics with Anna. Viewed in the dashboard Utilities tab.

fnc_commit_stall_cycles.effect: stalls commit of the fnc (first-not-committed) instruction, widening the speculative window

unresolved_stall_cycles.effect: holds branches unresolved longer (keeps the window open)

commitToIEWDelay.effect: needed to exercise the VP↔squash race gadget
commitToIEWDelay.notes: flagged in claudelog as not in stock pipeline

branch_ann_enable.effect: turns on the --branch-ann-file BTB override (force branch directions)
branch_ann_enable.applies_to: -modded / SPT builds ONLY (vanilla rejects the flag)
